propositions: ProviderSession construction at runner.py:294 sits outside the try-finally guard that ends at 501, causing httpx.AsyncClient leaks when pre-call code like _check_tool_capability raises

ProviderSession already implements __enter__ and __exit__ context manager protocol (providers.py:323/326) but is never used in runner.run(), making the documented pattern in providers.py:18-24 non-existent

Moving ProviderSession construction into a with statement that covers provider resolution through call and teardown eliminates the need for explicit finally close and prevents the pre-call window leak
The assert_gated security check at runner.py:261 must execute before any provider client is constructed, with fail-closed semantics preserved
_NoBuildProviderSession stub in test_execution_mode_dispatch.py lacks __enter__ and __exit__ methods, causing runtime failure once run() wraps ProviderSession in a with statement
A double-close would occur if both the with __exit__ and a redundant finally block attempt to close the session
